symptom_text: tomato ke patte neeche se sukhne lage hain, patton par gol gol bhure nishan hain ek ke andar ek circle jaisa
after the cloudy rainy days my tomato plants got big wet looking black patches and a white fuzz under the leaves
tomato leaves are rolled upwards and very small, plant not growing, lots of tiny white flying insects
one tomato plant suddenly fell down at noon while still green, I cut the stem and put in a glass of water and white milk like thread came out
paddy field leaves have eye shaped spots with grey inside, and some panicles broke at the neck and turned black
after heavy storm my paddy leaves are drying from the tip with yellow wavy stripes along the edges
rice plants have greyish green patches near the water level on the stem sheath and it is climbing upward, crop is very thick
dhan ke patton par chhote chhote til jaise bhure dhabbe hain, khet ki mitti kamzor hai
gehun ke patton par peele rang ki line me dhool jaisa powder hai jo haath me lag jata hai, thandi aur kohre wala mausam
wheat leaves have orange dots spread randomly on top side not in lines, late in season
white flour like coating on my wheat leaves, it wipes off, crop is dense and heavily fertilised
after threshing some wheat grains were half black powder and smelled like fish, rest of the ear was fine
cotton bolls have tiny holes and when I open them there are pink worms inside, flowers look twisted and closed
kapas leaves have square shaped water soaked spots between veins that turn brown, and black marks on the stem near the leaf stalk
groundnut leaflets covered with round dark brown spots each with a yellow ring, leaves falling a lot
moongphali ke patton ke neeche orange powder jaisa hai aur upar bhure dhabbe, patte jaldi gir rahe hain
sugarcane top leaves drooping and drying, when I split the cane lengthwise it is red inside with white bands and smells sour
ganna me kuch plants ke upar kale rang ka chabuk jaisa nikla hai aur baaki ganne patle ghaas jaise ho gaye hain
tomato fruit has dark hard sunken spot near the stem end and the stem near ground has dark lesion
tomato green fruits have firm brown blotches, whole plants collapsed in a week in cold foggy weather
tomato nursery seedlings were already curled and stunted before transplanting and whiteflies sit on them
my tomato field is waterlogged and plants wilt in patches during day, inside of stem is brown
rice seedlings in nursery look burnt and have spindle spots, weather very humid with cool nights
young rice seedlings wilted and died after transplanting and a yellow sticky ooze was seen on cut leaves in the morning
small white round hard balls floating on water in my rice field and lesions on the sheath with brown border
dark spots on rice grain husk and leaves, seedlings in nursery blighted, soil is poor and low in potash
yellow stripes on wheat flag leaf and ear, powder yellow on my clothes after walking through the field
gehun me patton par narangi bhure chhote chhote daane bikhre hue hain line me nahi
grey white patches on lower wheat leaves with some tiny black dots in old patches, cool humid weather
wheat ear had black dust in few grains only, flowering time had cloudy rainy days
cotton bolls opened early and the lint is stained, seeds eaten, crop is very old and I did not clear last years stalks
cotton seedlings had small spots on first leaves and later black stripe on stem, boll has greasy dark spot and rotting
groundnut plants lost almost all leaves, left over leaves have black circular spots, underside darker, I grew groundnut in same plot for years
peanut leaves have rusty orange pustules below and spores blowing from neighbours field, leaves drying
cane stalks hollow and shrunken, red inside, whole clump dried after heavy monsoon, I used the same cane as seed from last crop
sugarcane ratoon crop has many thin grassy shoots and some whip like black structures with silver skin releasing black dust
